name: wrong-key-version
description: A segment genuinely sealed under storage_key_version 2, scanned by a verifier that holds only version 1.
asserts: Structurally clean. Keyed: the provider refuses before deriving anything, with KEY_VERSION_MISMATCH, rather than deriving a version-1 key that would fail every tag. The difference matters: a version mismatch means a key is missing, a tag failure means tampering, and an operator must be told which. The segment is not damaged and must not be deleted.
